name: Empire Premium Food Berhad
overview: 2026年，Empire Premium Food Berhad 完成首次公开募股（IPO）并在马来西亚交易所上市，发行最多363,000,000股普通股。公司业务线未在公告中披露具体扩张、缩减或合约信息，仅通过季度业绩报告和股息公告反映经营与资本运作。
overview_en: In 2026, Empire Premium Food Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) and listed on Bursa Malaysia, issuing up to 363,000,000 ordinary shares. No specific expansion, reduction, or contract details for business segments were disclosed in the announcements; only quarterly results and dividend announcements reflected operations and capital actions.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 2026年完成IPO并上市，未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
segments.note_en: Completed IPO and listing in 2026, with no specific operational changes disclosed for business segments.

actions.text_en: Conducted an initial public offering of up to 363,000,000 ordinary shares and listed on Bursa Malaysia.
